newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Thai Telephone rated sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Thai Telephone rated sell.

text.p: Asia Equity Ltd recommended on Thursday that investors sell Thai Telephone and Telecommunication Plc stocks on expectations that its investment cost would increase further.

"Due to this higher cost, our estimated amortisation expense has increased significantly to 2.5 billion baht ($96.15 million) and 2.6 billion baht in 1997 and 1998 respectively," Asia Equity said in a research report.
Asia Equity said it expected that total investment cost of Thai Telephone and Telecommunication would rise to 51.5 billion baht from 46.5 billion.

"As a result of the unexpected high investment cost TT&T has issued more debt, at a higher average cost of debt. Thus, our projected net interest expense has risen by 17 percent for this year and next," Asia Equity said.
It said that it was not convinced that basic telephone service operation was profitable.

Thai Telephone and Telecommunication had five billion baht deferred project costs at the end of 1995. This amount rose to eight billion baht at the end of the third quarter last year, Asia Equity said.
Thai Telephone and Telecommunication was trading at 27 baht, up 1.50, at 0824 GMT on Thursday.
